thread:
alex: Heads-up — scheduling a microbatch wave tomorrow 09:30 PT for a few small rollouts (runtime perf tweak, embeddings quant change, and a tiny DB index). Trying to keep it compact, ~20min per lane. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness for each? :clock9:

maría: I can take runtime perf + KV cache smoke. I'll run the `kv-prefix-check` suite and watch tail for `cache-miss` spikes.

alex: awesome thanks @maría — add your smoke cmds in the runbook when you can.

tian: I'll take infra/canary side (autoscale + prow metrics). Will validate steady RPS at +/-10% and the p99 latency graph for the serving runtime.

sam: pinging for a quick CR on the runtime tweak — tiny PR: https://gh.redwood.ai/r/redwood-inference/pulls/7824 — it's just a kernel selection tweak, low risk but want a second pair of eyes.

jamie: DB index migration ETA? we need a minimal lock window. Avoiding >30s locks please.

alex: migration is a fast online index (pt-online-schema-change). Ops will schedule at start of wave lane 2. Target window 09:40–09:45 PT.

maría: smoke commands I'm planning to run (add to runbook):
```
# runtime perf smoke
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \ 
  'https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate?model=rw-runtime-small' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' >/dev/null; sleep 0.2; done

# kv cache sanity
kubectl exec -it svc/kv-cache -- /bin/sh -c "./kv-check --prefix test-wave"
```

I'll also watch: `/dash/query?panel=kv_miss_rate` and p99 latency panel.

tian: infra checklist quick:
- canary nodes drained? yes
- autoscale policy cooldown set to 30s
- alert mute for noise windows set to 15m
I'll post a final thumbs when done.

ops-bot: preflight: capacity check OK, canary pool available (3 nodes reserved). Scheduled maintenance windows: none.

deploy-bot: dry-run deploy for `runtime-tweaks/v1.3.5` succeeded in staging at 2026-03-24T17:12:03Z.

sam: CR merged. tagging @oncall in the runbook for rollback steps.

jamie: noted. I will prepare the online index job and the quick revert script (DROP INDEX IF CREATED) in case we need to back out.

alex: plan for rollout order (tentative): lane A — embeddings quant (09:30), lane B — index migration (09:40), lane C — runtime perf (09:50). Each lane has a 10–20m observation window. If any smoke fails -> immediate pause + rollback plan.

maría: I'll be live in the channel from 09:20. I'll post `:thumbsup:` when I start smoke and `:x:` if anything looks off.

tian: I'll be on-call for canary metrics and will cut traffic back to 0% if p99 > 500ms for >2min.

sam: quick note — the runtime tweak has a fallback flag `--kernel=compat` if we need instant fallback without a full deploy.

alex: perfect. Final ask: anyone else who wants to watch or take hotseat? please reply here. Otherwise I'll lock the window and add owners to the runbook. :lock: 

jamie: I'll watch the DB window and be ready to revert.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/microbatch-2026-03-25 (add owners before 09:00 PT)

alex: great — thanks everyone. See you in-channel tomorrow 09:20 PT for final preflight.
